notes.title: Gamescom Demo Patch #8
notes.notes:
- Better synced movement to attack animations
- Starting weapons/items now spawn equipped instead of inside the inventory
- Control improvements

notes.title: Gamescom Patch #7
notes.notes:
- Fixed keyboard pause issues introduced with controller update
- Changed jump and roll button mapping
- Fixed movement pause glitch
- Fixed hammer/great sword movement glitch

notes.title: Gamescom Demo Gamepad Update
notes.notes:
Players will now be able to play Exodus of Descent using a gamepad controller! View the controls at the main menu or choose the option within the pause menu during gameplay. The game and UI will auto-switch to using a gamepad once it is detected being used by the player.

Patch Notes:
- Added full controller support
- Changed dungeon key layout
- Fixed some menu bugs
- Fixed bug that enabled movement during ability usage
- Stability updates

notes.title: Gamescom Demo Patch #5
notes.notes:
- Fixed glitch with great sword/hammer movement lock
- Roll and jump button no longer procs when attacking
- Timer bug fixed
- Items that cannot be picked up bug fixed
- Aiming the bow, casting a spell, or using an ability now snaps the player character towards the direction of the camera

notes.title: Gamescom Demo Patch #4
notes.notes:
- Fixed camera glitch when jumping and aiming the bow
- Made dungeon easier to complete in the given 10min time window
- Increased arrow damage

notes.title: Gamescom Demo Patch #3
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug in the Bow & Arrow weapon class, player behaves as expected when getting hit while drawing the bow.
- Fixed bug where arrows get shot instantly
- Fixed bug when opening inventory and pausing the game, this combo no longer soft locks.

notes.title: Bow and Arrow Update
notes.notes:
The Bow & Arrow weapon type is now available!

- Added the Bow & Arrow weapon type to the default "Outlaw" class on spawn
- Added "arrows" as lootable items
- Fixed character movement glitch that would freeze player movement during hit animation / secondary attacks
- Fixed enemy AI glitch that would follow player during attack animations

NOTE: These changes are applied to the Gamescom demo currently live for playtesting. If playtesting, please report found bugs in the official discord forums.

Thanks!
TheCrisp
